newsitem.title: USA: Classic Restaurants agrees to merger.
newsitem.headline: Classic Restaurants agrees to merger.

text.p: Classic Restaurants International Inc said on Monday it has tentatively agreed to merge with Main Event Inc, a privately held restaurant and entertainment management company based in Dallas.
Established in 1987, Main Event activities have grown from one to over 25 venues and from over $700,000 to more than $27 million in annual sales.
Terms and conditions of this proposed non-cash transaction provide for the exchange of Main Event's restaurant and nightclub operations for Classic Restaurant's shares, Classic Restaurants said.
The closing of this transaction is subject to comprehensive due diligence and final approval of the terms by each company's board of directors and their respective shareholders.

Classic Restaurants operates two restaurant/theatres with several concepts connected under one roof, a company spokeswoman said. The company anticipates revenues of the combined companies for 1997 to exceed $30 million.
Further financial terms of the deal were not immediately available.
